import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportCanonicalBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivCurvePushforwardProducers

/-!
# Relative flattening for a sheaf with finite support

For a coherent sheaf with support finite over the base, relative flatness
is detected by its direct image, including after arbitrary base change.
Consequently the entry-ideal rank strata on the base give relative
flattening with a prescribed fibre length. This is the finite-support
case of Nitsure, Section 4, used in campaign D3 toward Kleiman's
Section 3 divisor theorem and Section 4 Picard representability theorem.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem coherentSheafFlat_iff_of_affine_support
    {Z X S : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsAffineHom i] [IsAffineHom (i ≫ f)]
    (N : Z.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent] (F : X.Modules)
    (e : F ≅ (pushforward i).obj N) :
    CoherentSheafFlat f F ↔
      CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 S) ((pushforward f).obj F) := by
  let e' : (pushforward (i ≫ f)).obj N ≅ (pushforward f).obj F :=
    (pushforwardComp i f).app N ≪≫ (pushforward f).mapIso e.symm
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hN : CoherentSheafFlat (i ≫ f) N :=
      CoherentSheafFlat.of_pushforward_of_isAffineHom i f N
      (coherentSheafFlat_of_iso f e h)
    intro U hU V hV hVU
    exact coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 S) e'
      (CoherentSheafFlat.pushforward_of_isAffineHom (i ≫ f) (𝟙 S) N
        (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact hN)) hU hV hVU
  · intro h
    have hN : CoherentSheafFlat ((i ≫ f) ≫ 𝟙 S) N :=
      CoherentSheafFlat.of_pushforward_of_isAffineHom (i ≫ f) (𝟙 S) N
      (coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 S) e'.symm h)
    intro U hU V hV hVU
    exact coherentSheafFlat_of_iso f e.symm
      (CoherentSheafFlat.pushforward_of_isAffineHom i f N
        (by rw [Category.comp_id] at hN; exact hN)) hU hV hVU

/-- Relative flatness of a quasi-coherent sheaf with finite schematic
support is equivalent to flatness of its direct image on the base. -/
theorem coherentSheafFlat_iff_pushforward_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ f)) :
    CoherentSheafFlat f F ↔
      CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 S) ((pushforward f).obj F) := by
  let i := schematicSupportι F
  let N := (pullback i).obj F
  haveI : IsAffineHom i :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsAffineHom F.annihilator.subschemeι)
  haveI : IsFinite (i ≫ f) := hfin
  haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom i F inferInstance
  exact coherentSheafFlat_iff_of_affine_support i f N F (schematicSupportDescentIso F)

/-- Finite-support flatness can be tested on the pulled-back direct image
under an arbitrary Cartesian base change. No flatness assumption is made
on the morphism changing the base. -/
theorem coherentSheafFlat_pullback_iff_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ f)) :
    CoherentSheafFlat f' ((pullback g').obj F) ↔
      CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 S') ((pullback g).obj ((pushforward f).obj F)) := by
  let i := schematicSupportι F
  let N := (pullback i).obj F
  let j := Limits.pullback.snd i g'
  let a := Limits.pullback.fst i g'
  haveI : IsAffineHom i :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsAffineHom F.annihilator.subschemeι)
  haveI : IsFinite (i ≫ f) := hfin
  haveI : IsAffineHom (i ≫ f) := inferInstance
  have sq₁ : IsPullback a j i g' := IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _
  have sqZ : IsPullback a (j ≫ f') (i ≫ f) g := sq₁.paste_vert sq
  haveI : IsAffineHom j :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ (inferInstance : IsAffineHom i)
  haveI : IsAffineHom (j ≫ f') := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sqZ inferInstance
  haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom i F inferInstance
  haveI : ((pullback a).obj N).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom a N inferInstance
  let e : (pullback g').obj F ≅ (pushforward j).obj ((pullback a).obj N) :=
    (pullback g').mapIso (schematicSupportDescentIso F) ≪≫
      pushforwardPullbackBaseChangeIso sq₁ N
  have h := coherentSheafFlat_iff_of_affine_support j f' ((pullback a).obj N)
    ((pullback g').obj F) e
  let e' := pullbackPushforwardIso_of_isFinite_schematicSupport sq F hfin
  exact h.trans ⟨coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 S') e'.symm,
    coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 S') e'⟩

section RankStratum

variable {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
  (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]

attribute [local instance] pushforward_isQuasicoherent

/-- Finite schematic support makes the direct image coherent over a
locally noetherian base, before any flatness is imposed. -/
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ f)) :
    ((pushforward f).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
  isFinitePresentation_of_finite_sections _ (fun _ hV =>
    module_finite_sections_pushforward_of_isFinite_schematicSupport f F hfin hV)

/-- The rank stratum of the direct image flattens the original sheaf
relative to the stratum, not just a module living on the base. -/
theorem coherentSheafFlat_pullback_rankStratum_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ f)) (d : ℕ) :
    CoherentSheafFlat
      (Limits.pullback.snd f (rankStratumι ((pushforward f).obj F) d))
      ((pullback (Limits.pullback.fst f
        (rankStratumι ((pushforward f).obj F) d))).obj F) :=
  (coherentSheafFlat_pullback_iff_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (rankStratumι ((pushforward f).obj F) d)) F hfin).mpr
    (coherentSheafFlat_rankStratum ((pushforward f).obj F) d)

/-- Any relatively flat test of the finite-support sheaf with prescribed
direct-image fibre rank factors uniquely through the canonical rank stratum.
The test morphism itself need not be flat. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_rankStratum_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ f))
    (d : ℕ) {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hflat : CoherentSheafFlat (Limits.pullback.snd f g)
      ((pullback (Limits.pullback.fst f g)).obj F))
    (hrank : ∀ t : T, pointRank S ((pushforward f).obj F) (g t) = d) :
    ∃! l : T ⟶ rankStratum ((pushforward f).obj F) d,
      l ≫ rankStratumι ((pushforward f).obj F) d = g := by
  haveI := isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_schematicSupport f F hfin
  apply existsUnique_factor_rankStratum ((pushforward f).obj F) d g
    ((coherentSheafFlat_pullback_iff_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g) F hfin).mp hflat) hrank

/-- The canonical locally closed rank stratum represents relative flatness
with fixed direct-image fibre rank for a finite-support sheaf. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_rankStratum_iff_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ f))
    (d : ℕ) {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) :
    (∃! l : T ⟶ rankStratum ((pushforward f).obj F) d,
      l ≫ rankStratumι ((pushforward f).obj F) d = g) ↔
      CoherentSheafFlat (Limits.pullback.snd f g)
        ((pullback (Limits.pullback.fst f g)).obj F) ∧
      ∀ t : T, pointRank S ((pushforward f).obj F) (g t) = d := by
  haveI := isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_schematicSupport f F hfin
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, _⟩
    haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom
      (rankStratumι ((pushforward f).obj F) d) ((pushforward f).obj F) inferInstance
    constructor
    · apply (coherentSheafFlat_pullback_iff_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g) F hfin).mpr
      rw [← hl]
      intro U hU V hV hVU
      exact coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 T)
        ((pullbackComp l (rankStratumι ((pushforward f).obj F) d)).app _)
        (coherentSheafFlat_id_pullback l _
          (coherentSheafFlat_rankStratum ((pushforward f).obj F) d)) hU hV hVU
    · intro t
      apply (mem_range_rankStratumι_iff ((pushforward f).obj F) d (g t)).mp
      exact ⟨l t, congrArg (fun a : T ⟶ S => a t) hl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hflat, hrank⟩
    exact existsUnique_factor_rankStratum_of_isFinite_schematicSupport
      f F hfin d g hflat hrank

end RankStratum

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
